notes.text: Drums Comp bus: compressor 'No Stressor', threshold -20 dB, attack 20 ms, release 50 ms; other parameters not set.
TALKBACK: no routing stated beyond Aux 8 / LCL 22, so no Main route; talkback destination to be decided at soundcheck.
Crowd: monitors only per instructions, so no Main route; it feeds MON1-MON6 sends at -144 pre.
Keys: only one keyboard (stereo pair), so no Keys bus; Keys goes direct to Main.
reply: 'unassigned_inputs' left out once; read as an empty list: no row left out on purpose, so code builds every input-list row no channel names

critic_findings.message: Conventions say aux channels get gain 20 dB, which was applied. critic_findings.message: The HOST is speech and the conventions give speech a 120 Hz high-pass, but an aux strip has no HPF. The instructions explicitly place HOST on an aux, so the HPF can't be built; the preset also lacks a filter. Confirm the engineer accepts no high-pass on the host mic.

Aux strips MUSIC (LCL 23-24) and Crowd (channel 23) patch conflict: Crowd was patched to AES50-A 24 per input-list order, which is fine, but the instructions say inputs start at AES50-A 1 and none of the stated LCL sockets (20, 22, 23-24) are shared. No conflict, but MUSIC on LCL 23-24 sits on the channel-factory default local patches; confirm they are wired.

Crowd is a band-sound mic with no colour, DCA or mute group, and its fader is down with no Main route (monitors only). Color is null though no category matches, which is acceptable, but the monitor sends are at -144 so it is silent in all monitors until raised.

MUSIC is background music, not band tracks, yet it carries MON1-6 sends; it also has gain_db 20 on a LCL source, which is fine. Main route is present as required. Monitor sends on external feeds are not called for by the conventions for non-band sources.

Drum channels get Drums and Drums Comp sends, but Floor tom 2 uses the 'Fl.Tom e604' preset and Sample Pad is placed in Drums by assumption; the input list gives Sample Pad as category drums so that is fine. More important: Crowd and the Aux strips have no DCA assignments; Speech DCA/mute group is declared by conventions but the HOST is not in them.

Drums Comp bus and the Drums bus are declared, but no Tracks, Speech, Strings or Horns DCAs/mute groups are created since there are no members; the 'Speech' DCA and mute group would have the HOST as a member only if it were not on aux. Confirm that the Speech DCA/mute group are intentionally omitted. -- quoting "Speech: Hosts, MCs, Podium Mics, Presenters, Pastors, etc."; "Speech: All speech channels"
